name: Taco Dip

ingredients.name: neutral oil, such as vegetable oil
smoked paprika, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: In a large skillet, heat oil over medium until shimmering. Add chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and smoked paprika, and stir until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in onions, water, and lime juice and cook, stirring occasionally, until onions soften and a light sauce forms, about 4 minutes. Transfer the mixture to a plate or small bowl to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

In a large bowl with a handheld electric mixer, beat sour cream and cream cheese on high speed until smooth, about 1 minute (alternatively, whisk vigorously for about 3 minutes). Add cooled onion mixture and continue beating on low speed, or stir until well combined, about 1 minute.

Spread mixture evenly in a shallow 10- or 28-cm serving bowl. Top evenly with lettuce, scallions, cheese, avocado, tomatoes, jalapeños, and olives. Finish with a drizzle of hot sauce or taco sauce and sprinkle with cilantro. Serve with tortilla chips or crutités.

schema_metadata.keywords: taco dip, taco dip recipe, dip recipe, creamy dip

description: Need an easy party dip? This make-ahead-friendly taco dip combines a creamy, flavor-packed base with all your favorite taco toppings for a crowd-pleasing appetizer.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Tortilla chips or crudités, for serving

Optional substitutions: plum tomatoes → Roma tomatoes; Hot sauce → taco sauce

Notes: You can substitute all the listed spices and salt with 3 tablespoons of your preferred taco seasoning blend or our homemade taco seasoning.

Make-ahead and storage: The dip can be made through step 2 and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
author: Leah Colins
